note: Capabilities the video-director may reference. Only entries with status 'installed' are usable in production. Reviewed by hand; `python -m contentos.production.direction registry` checks it against the files on disk.

capabilities.name: HyperFrames
capabilities.purpose: Default and only renderer for explainers: HTML/GSAP compositions rendered to MP4 from one paused, seek-safe timeline.
limitations: Compositions must follow hyperframes-core: one paused GSAP timeline, no randomness or wall-clock, no render-time network.
Version is pinned in package.json; upgrade deliberately.

capabilities.name: HyperFrames core
capabilities.purpose: Composition contract: scene clips, data-* timing, seek-safety and determinism rules.
limitations: Vendored from a pinned upstream commit (config/upstream-skills.lock.json); gitignored, so a fresh checkout needs `python scripts/upstream_skills.py sync`.

capabilities.name: HyperFrames animation
capabilities.purpose: Atomic motion rules, blueprints and the motion-analysis script.
limitations: Vendored from a pinned upstream commit (config/upstream-skills.lock.json); gitignored, so a fresh checkout needs `python scripts/upstream_skills.py sync`.

capabilities.name: HyperFrames keyframes
capabilities.purpose: Seek-safe keyframing, camera moves and keyframe diagnostics.
limitations: Vendored from a pinned upstream commit (config/upstream-skills.lock.json); gitignored, so a fresh checkout needs `python scripts/upstream_skills.py sync`.

capabilities.name: Explainer motion craft
capabilities.purpose: House motion rules R1-R6 for authoring explainer animation; the project's motion authority.

capabilities.name: Explainer visual QA
capabilities.purpose: Gates, phone-scale frame inspection, independent critic and A/B discipline; the project's QA authority.

capabilities.name: R1 Smooth settle
capabilities.purpose: Default entrance ease is power3.out. No back, elastic or bounce unless the brief asks for playful. (Upstream motion doctrine; Pilot 001 had 5 back.out pops, variant B has 0.)

capabilities.name: R2 Reveal on the spoken cue
capabilities.purpose: An element appears when its word is spoken, using cue(phrase, scene) from the aligned word timings, not at scene start. Do not dump a scene's content in its first quarter.

capabilities.name: R3 One world, one camera
capabilities.purpose: Move the #stage wrapper once per scene (about 0.6-0.9 s, power2.inOut), then HOLD.

capabilities.name: R4 Stillness beats fake life
capabilities.purpose: No scale "breathing", no repeat:-1, no decorative loops. A held frame is fine. (Upstream says this; one upstream skill says the opposite, "idle elements breathe", and was rejected for explainers.)

capabilities.name: R5 Safe zones
capabilities.purpose: Captions and key content inside the title-safe box (80%, 10% inset per edge); everything visible inside action-safe (90%).
limitations: 9:16 platform UI overlap zones are not verified; treat the portrait layout as unconfirmed.

capabilities.name: R6 Short statements
capabilities.purpose: One idea per shot; split a claim of more than about 6 words or turn it into a visual. Narration pace: upstream and a second skill both budget 2.3-2.5 words/s (about 140-150 wpm).

capabilities.name: Native HTML, SVG and CSS
capabilities.purpose: Text, labels, diagrams and simple animation written directly as HTML/inline SVG/CSS inside a HyperFrames composition and driven by the scene's GSAP timeline.
limitations: No text-card, stat-card or diagram templates exist in the repository (contentos/templates holds only gsap.min.js); each scene is authored per video.

capabilities.name: 3D camera flight
capabilities.purpose: Perspective camera FLIGHT through a 3D-laid-out world — one static perspective stage + preserve-3d .world whose pose (translate3d + rotateX/rotateY) is tweened leg-by-leg from a single camera state object: dive into an angled grid...

capabilities.name: 3D page scroll
capabilities.purpose: Full webpage rendered as a tilted 3D card whose internal content scrolls to reveal specific sections. Pair with asr-keyword-glow for on-page keyword highlighting.

capabilities.name: 3D text depth layers
capabilities.purpose: Multiple offset text layers (N divs at (i*dx, i*dy) with decreasing alpha) create a stacked 3D extrusion illusion on large typography.

capabilities.name: AI tracking box
capabilities.purpose: AI detection overlay — yellow #facc15 L-bracket corners + confidence label (fluctuating 95-99%) following a target on a sine arc path. Box position recomputed per-frame from target position (never tweened separately).

capabilities.name: Ambient glow bloom
capabilities.purpose: Un-triggered soft radial glow that blooms in behind a hero element and holds with a bounded idle breathe, or a single-pass traveling sheen across a surface. No click, no word-sync; peak opacity ≤ ~0.45, finite/deterministic.

capabilities.name: Anchored layout expand
capabilities.purpose: Edge-pinned container grows/collapses along ONE axis and in-flow content reflows — pill springs open into a dropdown, panel grows a sub-task stack, input card steps taller as typed text wraps, pane expands over a neighbor.

capabilities.name: ASR keyword glow
capabilities.purpose: Highlight keywords with glow + scale + color synced to ASR word timestamps. Two GSAP tweens per word drive a CSS custom property --glow through attack-decay-rest envelope.

capabilities.name: Avatar cloud network
capabilities.purpose: Avatars on an elliptical ring with SVG connection lines to a center point, staggered entry. Cloud center coordinates must match the centerpiece element exactly.

capabilities.name: Camera cursor tracking
capabilities.purpose: Two-phase virtual camera that locks the viewport to a moving focal point (typing cursor) — static initial framing then focal-point-locked tracking. Uses browser-native getBoundingClientRect() / ctx.measureText() after document.fonts.ready.

capabilities.name: Card morph anchor
capabilities.purpose: Container morphs apparent size + corner radius + surface treatment between two shots, then fades to reveal the real target underneath.

capabilities.name: Center outward expansion
capabilities.purpose: Elements start clustered at screen center and expand outward to final positions. Each element gets its target position via CSS once; GSAP tweens transform x / y offsets to 0 in lockstep with a shared driver.

capabilities.name: Chart scrub readout
capabilities.purpose: Cursor/playhead scrubs an already-drawn chart — ONE driver moves a vertical tracking line + marker along a baked data polyline while a date/value tooltip steps through the data array (text writes only on index change);

capabilities.name: Chromatic glitch
capabilities.purpose: RGB-split / slice glitch that snaps sharp — offset color copies jitter on a deterministic hash of QUANTIZED timeline time (never Math.random), or horizontal slice bands displace and converge under a stepped ease;

capabilities.name: Context sensitive cursor
capabilities.purpose: Typing cursor whose background-color switches at segment boundaries plus square-wave blink via (tl.time() % cycle) < cycle/2.

capabilities.name: Control target sync
capabilities.purpose: Live-sync couple — a scrubbed/typed/picked control and its bound target change in the SAME beat: readout tween + target transform tween share one timeline label, duration, and ease (continuous scrub), or one threshold state array...

capabilities.name: Coordinate target zoom
capabilities.purpose: Zoom into non-centered elements via scale (outer wrapper) + counter-translation (inner wrapper).

capabilities.name: Counting dynamic scale
capabilities.purpose: Counter where transform scale grows with the value for escalating emphasis. A numeric proxy and scale tween share one timeline position.

capabilities.name: CSS marker patterns
capabilities.purpose: Pure CSS + GSAP implementations of marker-highlight drawing modes — highlight (yellow sweep), circle (hand-drawn ellipse), burst (radiating lines), scribble (chaotic), sketchout (rough rectangle outline).

capabilities.name: Cursor click ripple
capabilities.purpose: Animated cursor moves to a target, depresses cursor + target together on click, emits an expanding ripple with attack-decay opacity envelope. Element lives in DOM from t=0 with opacity: 0 (no conditional rendering).

capabilities.name: Cursor drag
capabilities.purpose: The drag verb for driven cursors — grab (press dip + lift), travel (semi-transparent ghost rides the cursor in exact lockstep via matched tweens), drop-snap into a placed field with selection chrome.

capabilities.name: Depth of field blur
capabilities.purpose: Selective rack-focus — GSAP-tween filter: blur() (+ slight opacity dim) on off-focus layers via a --dof var while the focal element stays sharp; single pull, two-plane rack, or blur-the-cluster-while-pushing-in.

capabilities.name: Depth scatter assemble
capabilities.purpose: N elements scatter into / reassemble from a rotating 3D depth-cloud — each starts at a deterministic index-derived 3D offset (translateZ + rotateX/Y + scatter) and settles to a clean flat layout; tumble-swap and radial-explode variants.

capabilities.name: Discrete text sequence
capabilities.purpose: Replace entire text states at time thresholds for non-linear typing (typos, holds, bulk additions, backspaces). GSAP onUpdate-driven reverse search.

capabilities.name: Dynamic content sequencing
capabilities.purpose: Pre-compute a flat [{startTime, endTime, ...}] array from a script of {textMain, textAccent, charSpeed, hold} entries. Each phrase's window = chars × charSpeed + hold. Content-driven duration, no hand-tuned offsets.

capabilities.name: Gradient text sweep
capabilities.purpose: A gradient tweened THROUGH letterforms — background-clip: text + an oversized-background backgroundPosition tween.

capabilities.name: GSAP effects
capabilities.purpose: Drop-in GSAP timeline patterns — typewriter, audio visualizer, and other reusable choreography blocks.

capabilities.name: Hacker flip 3D
capabilities.purpose: Character-level 3D rotation with deterministic glyph substitution (decryption). GSAP back.out ease + per-glyph onUpdate for the flicker hash.

capabilities.name: Kinetic beat slam
capabilities.purpose: Percussive kinetic typography — short phrases slam in on ONE shared beat array with DISTINCT per-phrase entrances (scale-slam / side-snap / rise-rotate), optional rhythm chrome (metronome ticks, beat bar), then a locked finale.

capabilities.name: Motion blur streak
capabilities.purpose: Fake directional velocity blur on a fast entrance / camera push-through — blur peaks at max speed, resolves to 0 at the settle.

capabilities.name: Multi cursor choreography
capabilities.purpose: N (2–4) labeled independent cursor actors work one canvas simultaneously — collaborative-canvas ambience.

capabilities.name: Multi phase camera
capabilities.purpose: Sequential camera-zoom system (pull-back / focus / push) plus continuous micro-drift.

capabilities.name: Nudge curve
capabilities.purpose: Slow-fast-slow three-phase group slide (power3.in ramp → linear burst → power4.out tail, 10/65/25 distance, tail ≥3× ramp-in) to reposition a composed group and reveal content during the burst.

capabilities.name: Orbit 3D entry
capabilities.purpose: Elements flip in from 3D space (rotateX + rotateY + translateZ) then settle into a continuous elliptical orbit. Critical: entry MUST flip in-place at the orbital starting position (gsap.set BEFORE phase 1), not at scene center.

capabilities.name: Particle burst
capabilities.purpose: Deterministic particle / confetti events — confetti pop that bursts up and drifts down on gravity (optional instant-shrink), dot burst from behind text, glyph dissolve to particles.

capabilities.name: Physics press reaction
capabilities.purpose: Physical click simulation — two sequential GSAP scale tweens (down to 0.9, up to 1.0) approximate a spring with overshoot. Pass a single targets array ["#cta", "#cursor"] to compress both together for tactile contact feel.

capabilities.name: Press release spring
capabilities.purpose: Tactile button press: linear compression then spring recovery via two adjacent GSAP tweens on the same property. Variations: color transition, shadow depth via CSS vars, release burst, background glow.

capabilities.name: Reactive displacement
capabilities.purpose: Physical-collision transition where an entering element's GSAP tween drives the exiting element's displacement. Three concurrent tweens at the same timeline position with victim durations 40-50% of the intruder's.

capabilities.name: Scale swap transition
capabilities.purpose: Coordinated morph between two DOM elements at the same screen center. Exit cluster shrinks + fades; entrance pops in with back.out(2) overshoot.

capabilities.name: Sine wave loop
capabilities.purpose: Continuous breathing/idle ambient motion. Two forms: GSAP sine.inOut yoyo with finite repeats (preferred when standalone) or onUpdate reading tl.time() (preferred when multiplying onto another live value).

capabilities.name: Split tilt cards
capabilities.purpose: Two cards side-by-side with opposing rotationY tilts (+/- baseTilt) and entry slides from their respective sides. Continuous floating runs in phase opposition (Math.PI offset).

capabilities.name: Spring pop entrance
capabilities.purpose: The canonical ENTRANCE pop — an element (or staggered group) arrives by springing scale: 0 → 1 with back.out overshoot, fromTo so it's correct at t=0 under seek. Single hero, staggered group (≤500ms cap), overshoot tuned by personality.

capabilities.name: Stat bars and fills
capabilities.purpose: Data-viz primitives that pair a number with a graphic — growth bars (CSS scaleY stagger), progress fill (bar scaleX or measured SVG ring), and fractional star-rating wipe (clip-path). Transforms only, seek-safe.

capabilities.name: SVG icon enrichment
capabilities.purpose: Animate internal SVG elements (rotating hands, oscillating blades, pulsing dots, dash-flow lines) so icons feel alive.

capabilities.name: SVG path draw
capabilities.purpose: SVG outline draws itself stroke-by-stroke via stroke-dasharray / stroke-dashoffset. Measure with getTotalLength() at composition setup, set initial dashoffset = length, GSAP tweens to 0.

capabilities.name: Theme crossfade morph
capabilities.purpose: Whole-theme in-place morph under a fixed anchor — background, typography, radii, icons, chrome and logos blend simultaneously (~0.3s) through N pre-styled skins while one anchor element never moves.

capabilities.name: Vertical spring ticker
capabilities.purpose: Slot-machine vertical scrolling using stepped GSAP tweens within a masked column.

capabilities.name: Viewport change
capabilities.purpose: Virtual camera — simulate zoom / pan / focus-lock by transforming a single .world wrapper containing all scene content. Single-element composite transform translate(x,y) scale(S);

capabilities.name: Waterfall entry
capabilities.purpose: Staggered ARRIVAL cascade — words/elements whip in from below, each starting before the previous settles, an accelerating wave that resolves composed. Title cards, segment openers, list intros.

capabilities.purpose: N items (tiles / cards / logos / list-lines) self-assemble in a staggered cascade into a grid or vertical list and hold — a "look how much / who / what it does" beat that enumerates breadth at once;

capabilities.purpose: The AI-era demo shot — a [prompt / query / command] types character-by-character into a REAL product input (chat composer, search bar, terminal prompt, URL bar, sidebar assistant) and the machine answers: status...

capabilities.purpose: The calm breather/landing beat — one clean title or single brand/proof card revealed with exactly one restrained move (a slide-up crossfade, or a wipe-away-to-reveal), then a still hold.

capabilities.purpose: The frame travels vertically along ONE long content surface — an agent transcript, a running task feed, an analysis document, a story draft — rendered full-bleed on a flat canvas (no device frame, no held mockup), by...

capabilities.purpose: A live text caret types (and edits) a line as a human would, then either collapses it to a point and pops a brand payoff, or holds it under a persistent brand mark while a sub-line types/swaps into the final CTA...

capabilities.purpose: A product video holds center and claims attention, then slides aside to hand its weight to a hero stat in the space it vacates, then both clear and kinetic text types into the center — accent words carrying the...

capabilities.purpose: Open TIGHT on one full-bleed detail — a graphic macro or a small UI region — let micro-action play in close-up, then ONE continuous decelerating zoom-out reveals that everything seen so far lives inside a containing...

capabilities.name: Word alignment
capabilities.purpose: Aligns script words to ASR output so narration cues resolve to real times.

capabilities.name: Scene plan resolver
capabilities.purpose: Resolves sceneplan/1 narration anchors into scene times; builds the timestamped storyboard.

capabilities.name: Frame preview
capabilities.purpose: Extracts frames and contact sheets from a project or MP4 for phone-scale inspection.

capabilities.name: Motion audit
capabilities.purpose: Measures easing inventory, one-frame pops and still fraction of a build or render.
limitations: Advisory metrics; not a blocking gate.

capabilities.name: Critic report check
capabilities.purpose: Validates an independent critic's JSON report and recomputes the verdict from its scores.
limitations: Pass thresholds are provisional and uncalibrated.

capabilities.name: Animation map
capabilities.purpose: Static analysis of a composition's tweens (paced-slow, dead zones, collisions) from the vendored hyperframes-animation skill.
limitations: Collision counts are usually by design; do not gate on them.
capabilities.status_reason: Installs nothing unless opted in: set HYPERFRAMES_SKILL_PKG_VERSION=0.8.114 and, after reading scripts/package-loader.mjs, HYPERFRAMES_SKILL_BOOTSTRAP_DEPS=1 (see explainer-motion-craft); the bootstrap fetches packages.

capabilities.name: MoneyPrinterTurbo stock-footage lane
capabilities.purpose: Whole-video render lane (render: mpt) that cuts free stock footage to the project's own voice track and burns subtitles.
limitations: A separate lane for a whole video, not a per-scene technique inside a HyperFrames composition; scene-level use is not integrated.
Only pexels, pixabay, coverr and user-supplied footage are passed; user-supplied rights are not verified by contentos.
capabilities.status_reason: Needs the moneyprinterturbo-api container running and free stock-source API keys configured; fetches footage over the network.

capabilities.name: Hand-drawn p5.brush treatment
capabilities.purpose: Optional pre-rendered hand-drawn texture (ink, charcoal, watercolour) for diagram marks, revealed by HyperFrames masks.
limitations: Specialist asset generator, not a renderer; no module is built.
Strokes cannot be grown by redrawing; snapshots are pre-rendered and revealed with masks.
WebGL2 is needed at asset-generation time; Metal and software back-ends are not byte-identical, so one must be pinned.
Project assets about 4x larger; visual A/B judgement is still pending.
capabilities.status_reason: Verdict KEEP EXPERIMENTAL in 09; promotion needs an explicit owner decision.

capabilities.name: Vibe filters
capabilities.purpose: Named in the brief as a possible visual treatment; no implementation has been identified.
capabilities.status_reason: No concrete implementation, dependency or asset found in the repository (the only 'vibe' hits are prose in vendor/OpenMontage); not usable until one is identified and verified.

capabilities.name: Motion AI Kit (motiondivision/ai-kit)
capabilities.purpose: Animation tooling for interactive web UI built on the Motion library and CSS.
limitations: Docs search and spring generation need hosted MCP servers; MotionScore audits, example source and the transition editor need paid Motion+.
The repository ships no LICENSE file (MIT is only declared in package metadata), so its text must not be vendored.
capabilities.status_reason: Reference-only decision in 10 (sections 1 and 2.1): interactive web UI tool, hosted/paid dependencies, unclear licence.
